title: Import the Westbrook course catalog
text:
During the beta students typed their courses by hand, which gave us "Calc 2", "Calculus II" and "MATH 152" as three different courses and made matching worse.

**Plan**

* Import the Westbrook University catalog (course code, title, term) into `pairly-api`
* Replace free text in onboarding with a searchable course picker
* Merge existing hand-typed courses into catalog entries where possible

Build the importer so the same format works for Lakeside College in January. Daniel owns it; Maya is asking the registrar for the data file.
